WITH measurement_combined  AS (
    SELECT person_id, measurement_date, avg(value_as_number) AS value_as_number, cohort_start_date,cohort_end_date 
    FROM (SELECT m.person_id, m.measurement_date, m.value_as_number, ct.cohort_start_date, ct.cohort_end_date 
          FROM  @cdm_database_schema.measurement m 
          JOIN @cohort_table ct ON m.person_id = ct.subject_id 
         WHERE ct.cohort_definition_id=@cohort_id 
         AND  m.measurement_concept_id IN              (1002881,1003116,1003232,1003304,1003850,1003912,1333027,3008989,3013842,3015514,3019171,3023540,3035463,3036277,4030731,4093972,4093975,4103356,4154781,4177340,4275188,36315258,37020737,40192450,40655804,40759186,45876161,46273922)   
         AND m.value_as_number>0
         AND m.measurement_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -730, ct.cohort_start_date) AND m.measurement_date <= ct.cohort_end_date
         
         UNION ALL 
          SELECT o.person_id, o.observation_date AS measurement_date, o.value_as_number, ct.cohort_start_date, ct.cohort_end_date 
          FROM  @cdm_database_schema.observation o
          JOIN @cohort_table ct ON o.person_id = ct.subject_id 
         WHERE ct.cohort_definition_id= @cohort_id AND  o.observation_concept_id IN                   (1002881,1003116,1003232,1003304,1003850,1003912,1333027,3008989,3013842,3015514,3019171,3023540,3035463,3036277,4030731,4093972,4093975,4103356,4154781,4177340,4275188,36315258,37020737,40192450,40655804,40759186,45876161,46273922)  
         AND o.value_as_number>0
         AND o.observation_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -730, ct.cohort_start_date) AND o.observation_date <= ct.cohort_end_date
    ) HMA
    GROUP BY person_id, measurement_date,cohort_start_date, cohort_end_date 
),
height_measurement  AS (    
    SELECT  *, 
    CASE WHEN  person_id in (SELECT DISTINCT person_id FROM measurement_combined WHERE measurement_date = cohort_start_date ) THEN 1 
         ELSE 0 END AS baseline_height_flag,
    CASE WHEN measurement_date < cohort_start_date THEN 1 
         ELSE 0 END AS before_index_flag,
    CASE WHEN measurement_date > cohort_start_date AND measurement_date <= cohort_end_date THEN 1 
         ELSE 0 END AS  after_index_flag,
    CASE WHEN measurement_date > cohort_start_date AND measurement_date <= cohort_end_date THEN 1 
         ELSE 0 END AS before_follow_up_flag
    FROM measurement_combined
),
drug_info  AS (
SELECT de.person_id , de.drug_exposure_start_date, de.drug_exposure_end_date,days_supply,ct.cohort_start_date, avg(de.quantity) quantity , de.drug_concept_id,  c.concept_name,
ct.cohort_end_date,  (drug_exposure_end_date - drug_exposure_start_date) +1 as days_supply_caculate
FROM @cdm_database_schema.drug_exposure de
JOIN  @cohort_table ct 
ON de.person_id = ct.subject_id
JOIN  @cdm_database_schema.concept_ancestor ca 
ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
JOIN  @cdm_database_schema.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id 
WHERE ct.cohort_definition_id=@cohort_id AND ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (21602690, 1584910 )  
GROUP BY de.person_id , de.drug_exposure_start_date, de.drug_exposure_end_date,days_supply,ct.cohort_start_date,
ct.cohort_end_date ,c.concept_name, de.drug_concept_id 
),
height_range_2  AS
(SELECT  hm.*, dd.date_diff, dd.max_date_before_index
FROM  height_measurement hm 
JOIN (
    SELECT person_id, cohort_start_date - max_date_before_index  AS date_diff ,max_date_before_index, cohort_start_date
    FROM (SELECT m.person_id, MAX(m.measurement_date) max_date_before_index , m.cohort_start_date
          FROM height_measurement m
          WHERE before_index_flag =1
          GROUP BY m.person_id,m.cohort_start_date)  measurement_day
        ) dd ON  hm.person_id = dd.person_id 
WHERE hm.baseline_height_flag =0 AND hm.measurement_date >= dd.max_date_before_index AND hm.measurement_date <= hm.cohort_start_date 
),
height_range_3  AS (
SELECT hm.*, dd.date_diff, dd.min_date_after_index
--select * 
FROM height_measurement hm
JOIN (
    SELECT person_id, min_date_after_index - cohort_start_date AS date_diff ,min_date_after_index
    FROM (SELECT person_id, MIN(m.measurement_date) min_date_after_index , m.cohort_start_date
          FROM height_measurement m
          WHERE after_index_flag =1
          GROUP BY m.person_id,m.cohort_start_date) hr_3
        ) dd ON  hm.person_id = dd.person_id 
WHERE hm.measurement_date > hm.cohort_start_date AND measurement_date <= dd.min_date_after_index  
),
height_range_4  AS (
SELECT hm.*, dd.date_diff, dd.max_date_before_follow_up 
FROM height_measurement hm
JOIN (
    SELECT person_id, max_date_before_follow_up - cohort_start_date AS date_diff ,max_date_before_follow_up
    FROM (SELECT person_id, MAX(m.measurement_date) max_date_before_follow_up , m.cohort_start_date
          FROM height_measurement m
          WHERE after_index_flag =1 
          GROUP BY m.person_id,m.cohort_start_date) HR_4
        ) dd ON  hm.person_id = dd.person_id 
WHERE measurement_date = dd.max_date_before_follow_up ),
height_range_4_1  AS (
SELECT hm.*, dd.date_diff, dd.max_date_before_follow_up ,dd.max_drug_date
FROM height_measurement hm
JOIN (
    SELECT hi.person_id,   max_date_before_follow_up - max_drug_date AS date_diff ,max_date_before_follow_up, max_drug_date
    FROM (SELECT person_id, MAX(m.measurement_date) max_date_before_follow_up , m.cohort_start_date
          FROM height_measurement m
          WHERE after_index_flag =1 
          GROUP BY m.person_id,m.cohort_start_date) hi
    JOIN (SELECT person_id, max(drug_exposure_start_date) max_drug_date FROM drug_info group by person_id) di ON di.person_id = hi.person_id
       WHERE date_diff>=0 ) dd ON  hm.person_id = dd.person_id 
WHERE measurement_date = dd.max_date_before_follow_up ),
height_range_4_2  AS (
SELECT hm.*, dd.date_diff, dd.max_date_before_follow_up ,dd.max_drug_date
FROM height_measurement hm
JOIN (
    SELECT hi.person_id,   max_drug_date - max_date_before_follow_up  AS date_diff ,max_date_before_follow_up, max_drug_date
    FROM (SELECT person_id, MAX(m.measurement_date) max_date_before_follow_up , m.cohort_start_date
          FROM height_measurement m
          WHERE after_index_flag =1 
          GROUP BY m.person_id,m.cohort_start_date) hi
    JOIN (SELECT person_id, max(drug_exposure_start_date) max_drug_date FROM drug_info group by person_id) di ON di.person_id = hi.person_id
       WHERE date_diff>0 ) dd ON  hm.person_id = dd.person_id 
WHERE measurement_date = dd.max_date_before_follow_up ),
height_range_5  AS (
SELECT  rc_height.* FROM (
    SELECT count( hm.measurement_date) cc , hm.person_id
    FROM height_measurement hm
    WHERE hm.measurement_date > hm.cohort_start_date AND hm.measurement_date <= cohort_end_date
    GROUP BY hm.person_id
) rc_height ),
height_range_6  AS (
SELECT  * FROM 
    (SELECT (MAX(m.measurement_date)-MIN(m.measurement_date)) / COUNT(m.measurement_date) cc,person_id
    FROM  height_measurement m 
    WHERE baseline_height_flag =1 AND m.measurement_date <= m.cohort_end_date AND m.measurement_date >= m.cohort_start_date  
    GROUP BY m.person_id) height 
WHERE  cc <>0 
),
height_range_7  AS (
SELECT *FROM 
    (SELECT (MAX(hm.measurement_date)-MIN(hm.measurement_date)) / COUNT(hm.measurement_date) AS cc ,hm.person_id
    FROM  height_measurement hm 
    JOIN (SELECT person_id, max_date_before_index - cohort_start_date  AS date_diff ,max_date_before_index, cohort_start_date
        FROM (SELECT m.person_id, MAX(m.measurement_date) max_date_before_index , m.cohort_start_date
              FROM height_measurement m
              WHERE before_index_flag =1 
              GROUP BY m.person_id,m.cohort_start_date) hr7a
            ) dd ON  hm.person_id = dd.person_id 
WHERE hm.baseline_height_flag =0 AND hm.measurement_date >= dd.max_date_before_index AND hm.measurement_date <= hm.cohort_end_date  
GROUP BY hm.person_id) height  where  cc <>0 ),
height_range_8  AS (
SELECT * FROM 
    (SELECT hm.person_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(hm.measurement_date)-1 <>0 THEN (MAX(hm.measurement_date)-MIN(hm.measurement_date)) / (COUNT(hm.measurement_date) -1) 
    ELSE 99999 END AS  cc
    FROM  height_measurement hm
    JOIN (
        SELECT person_id,  min_date_after_index - cohort_start_date  AS date_diff ,min_date_after_index
        FROM (SELECT person_id, MIN(m.measurement_date) min_date_after_index , m.cohort_start_date
              FROM height_measurement m
              WHERE after_index_flag =1 
              GROUP BY m.person_id,m.cohort_start_date) hr8a
            ) dd ON  hm.person_id = dd.person_id 
    WHERE  hm.measurement_date >= dd.min_date_after_index AND hm.measurement_date <= hm.cohort_end_date 
    GROUP BY hm.person_id ) height 
WHERE cc<>99999),
height_range_9  AS (SELECT   * FROM (
    SELECT COUNT( distinct drug_exposure_start_date) cc, person_id 
    FROM drug_info di 
    WHERE  di.drug_exposure_start_date >= di.cohort_start_date
    AND di.drug_exposure_start_date <= di.cohort_end_date
    GROUP BY di.person_id
) drug_rc ),
height_range_10  AS (
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT di.person_id,SUM(di.days_supply_caculate) / COUNT(di.days_supply_caculate) AS average_days
    FROM drug_info di
    WHERE di.drug_exposure_start_date >= di.cohort_start_date and di.drug_exposure_start_date <= di.cohort_end_date
    GROUP BY di.person_id
) di2 ),
height_range_10_1  AS (
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT di.person_id,SUM(di.days_supply) / COUNT(di.days_supply) AS average_days
    FROM drug_info di
    GROUP BY di.person_id
) di2),
height_range_10_2  AS (SELECT  * FROM 
    (SELECT di.person_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(di.drug_exposure_start_date)-1 <>0 THEN (MAX(di.drug_exposure_start_date)-MIN(di.drug_exposure_start_date)) / (COUNT(di.drug_exposure_start_date) -1) 
    ELSE 99999 END AS  cc
    FROM  drug_info di
    WHERE di.drug_exposure_start_date >= di.cohort_start_date AND di.drug_exposure_start_date <= di.cohort_end_date 
    GROUP BY di.person_id
    ) drug_info_final
WHERE cc<>99999 )

SELECT 
10001 AS covariate_id, 
       CONCAT( ROUND(height_min_value,0), ';', cast(min_range as decimal(18,2)), ';', cast(height_Q1 as decimal(18,2)) , ';',cast(height_median_value as decimal(18,0)), ';', cast(height_Q3 as decimal(18,0)), ';', cast(max_range as decimal(18,2)), ';', ROUND(height_max_value,0), ';', cast(height_avg_value as decimal(18,2)), ';', cast(height_sd_value as decimal(18,2))  ) AS covariate_name,
       1 AS concept_id, 
       ROUND(height_patient_count,0) AS sum_value, 
       cast(height_rc_count/100 as decimal(18,2)) AS average_value
FROM (
SELECT MIN(height_rc_count) AS height_rc_count,MIN(height_patient_count) AS  height_patient_count,MIN(height_min_value) AS height_min_value, 
min(value_as_number) AS min_range,MIN(height_Q1) AS height_Q1 ,MIN(height_median_value) AS height_median_value,
 MIN(height_Q3) AS height_Q3, max(value_as_number) AS max_range,MIN(height_max_value) AS height_max_value,
 MIN(height_avg_value) AS height_avg_value, MIN(height_sd_value) AS height_sd_value
FROM(
SELECT height_Q1 - (1.5*(height_Q3 - height_Q1)) AS MIN_RANGE, height_Q3 + (1.5*(height_Q3 - height_Q1)) AS MAX_RANGE,*
FROM
(SELECT COUNT(measurement_date) height_rc_count, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) height_patient_count,  
MIN(m.value_as_number) AS height_min_value, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.value_as_number) height_Q1,

PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.value_as_number) height_Q3,

  COUNT(*)                                                                            AS sum_value,

       SELECT DISTINCT

  CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) total_cnt
              FROM @cohort_table
              WHERE cohort_definition_id = @cohort_id) stat
GROUP BY drug_concept_id, c.concept_name, stat.total_cnt
